title: Reporting on comparative statements — five clients
instructions: Select the reporting element each situation requires in the current-year auditor's report (nonissuers).

rows.label: Prior-year statements were audited by a predecessor whose report isn't reissued
rows.explanation: The report describes the predecessor's audit and opinion.

rows.label: Prior-year statements were restated to correct a material misstatement, properly disclosed
rows.explanation: AU-C 708 requires emphasis for a correction of a material misstatement.

rows.label: Last year's qualified opinion is now unmodified on the prior year because the statements were restated
rows.explanation: An updated opinion that differs from the prior one is explained in an other-matter paragraph.

rows.label: Both years were audited by the current auditor with unmodified opinions and no changes
rows.explanation: The opinion simply covers both years.

rows.label: Prior-year statements were reviewed, not audited
rows.explanation: The report states the prior-year statements were reviewed and the limited assurance given.
